task_metadata.priority: P0 CRITICAL / LIMITED CORRECTION / SAME STAGE / NO PILOT AUTHORIZATION

P0-B1_verified_outcome_checker.fix: Replaced shallow planner response check with R1-R8 transcript inspection: full 64-char sha256 or exact job_id correlation, rootConversationId match, rejection of confirmation questions ('Начинаем?'), rejection of soft-denied/unhandled tool errors, verified executed action and acceptance artifacts, and detection of trailing malformed JSONL lines

P0-E1_fail_closed_security_boundary.fix: Default security profile changed to UNVERIFIED (no longer self-fulfilling SAFE_WORKTREE_SCOPED); verify_security_boundary() enforces security_boundary.json with enforce_write_boundary=True and rejects prohibited production roots (metadata.db, repo); returns BLOCKED_SETUP_REQUIRED with 0 runner calls on unproven permissions

P0-C1_durable_dispatch_intent_and_launch.fix: Saves durable DISPATCHING_INTENT in active_execution before launcher invocation; launcher timeout (exit 124), empty stdout, missing conversationId, or crashed intent recovery places worktree into WORKTREE_QUARANTINED with quarantine=True; second task is never dispatched concurrently

A4R-01.name: test_a4r_01_unproven_security_profile_blocked_setup_required
A4R-01.expected: BLOCKED_SETUP_REQUIRED with 0 runner calls on unproven profile or missing boundary config
A4R-01.observed: BLOCKED_SETUP_REQUIRED returned, runner called 0 times across all 4 unproven configurations

A4R-02.name: test_a4r_02_verified_security_boundary_allows_scoped_rejects_production
A4R-02.expected: Valid boundary config allows dispatch; inclusion of production root fails closed (0 calls)
A4R-02.observed: Valid config dispatched; prohibited root in allowed_write_roots blocked fail-closed (0 calls)

A4R-03.name: test_a4r_03_metadata_only_and_user_input_only_not_running_nor_succeeded
